text:
[issue by purefuryrealofficial] ### Description I noticed while playing with the create mod PSI on contraptions can't interact with the oppsite PSI connected to a storage block both in base game and modded storage blocks. I'm using **_NeoForge 21.1.256: Java version 1.21.1_**. The mods are **_Create, Sophisticated backpacks. Sophisticated storage, Sophisticated Storage Create Integration, Sophisticated Backpacks Create Integration, Create: Sophisticated Backpacks Compat_**. I tried using both base game storage and modded storage. It sometimes work but then randomly will stop working and then the contraption won't pick up it items(e.g. a harvester and carrots). Then it will sometimes pick them up but then not move them from the contraption storage to the connecting PSI storage [latest.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33467384/latest.log) ### Game Log https://mclo.gs/7vuo610 - (client) https://mclo.gs/AjaPXXX - (server) ### Debug Information
